title: File the annual unclaimed property holder report (Illinois)
description: Businesses holding property that has gone unclaimed — uncashed payroll or vendor checks, customer credits and refunds, unused gift cards, deposits — must report and turn it over to the state each year, after sending the owner a due diligence notice before the deadline. The annual report and payment are due May 1 for general property. Report before May 1; payment is made when the report is uploaded. A negative report is required only of business holders with sales over $1 million, publicly traded securities, net worth over $10 million or more than 100 employees. One vendor source gives April 30 for corporations and October 31 for financial institutions. Which state's law applies depends on the owner's last known address, or the business's state of incorporation when there is none, so a business can owe reports to several states.
